audience.text: Java developers building server-side or desktop applications that require PDF document generation, manipulation, and extraction without third-party runtime dependencies.

capabilities.text: Build pages from scratch using Document, Page, and Paragraphs to add text, tables, and annotations.
capabilities.title: Create and edit PDF content

capabilities.text: Use TextAbsorber to extract plain text and iterate page resources to save embedded images as files.
capabilities.title: Extract text and images

capabilities.text: Read and modify AcroForm fields including TextBoxField, RadioButtonOptionField, and other field types.
capabilities.title: Work with interactive forms

capabilities.text: Set and retrieve border color, background color, and border style for widget annotations and form fields.
capabilities.title: Configure annotation appearance

capabilities.text: Convert PDF pages to raster formats such as BMP, GIF, JPEG, PNG, and multi-page TIFF using device classes.
capabilities.title: Render pages to images

capabilities.text: Apply PKCS#7 digital signatures and encrypt documents using AES or RC4 with user/owner passwords.
capabilities.title: Sign and secure documents

capabilities.text: Reduce file size through stream recompression, duplicate linking, and resource subsetting.
capabilities.title: Optimize document size

capabilities.text: Validate documents against PDF/A standards and convert existing PDFs to PDF/A-1 through PDF/A-4.
capabilities.title: Validate and convert to PDF/A

limitations.text: No OCR support for text recognition in scanned images.
Conversion to non-PDF formats other than HTML/XML is not supported.
Concurrency is not supported for a single Document instance; use one instance per thread.
Text replacement with non-Latin scripts may differ from reference renderers in complex bidirectional cases.
Resource optimization has limited advanced strategies such as image downsampling profiles and font merging.
Tagged PDF structure tree coverage for full compliance is partial.

problems_solved.text: Enables programmatic creation and editing of PDF documents including text, tables, forms, annotations, and images using a consistent object model.
Supports extraction of plain text and images from existing PDFs for indexing, analysis, or reuse.
Provides form field population and interaction through AcroForm support including text boxes, radio buttons, checkboxes, and combo boxes.
Allows rendering of PDF pages to raster images and extraction of individual images embedded in the document.

product_summary.text: Aspose.PDF FOSS for Java is a free, open-source, pure-Java library for creating, reading, and modifying PDF documents compliant with ISO 32000-1:2008.

uncertainties: The exact set of public API types beyond the documented core classes and their method signatures is not fully enumerated in the facts.
Whether the library supports PDF/X or 3D annotations beyond stating they are out of scope is not confirmed.
The behavior of PdfFileSecurity.setAllowExceptions in edge cases is not detailed beyond throwing UnsupportedOperationException.

workflows.name: Create PDF from scratch
workflows.text: Instantiate a Document, add a Page, insert TextFragment or WidgetAnnotation objects, and save to disk.

workflows.name: Extract text from PDF
workflows.text: Load a Document, create a TextAbsorber, call accept on pages, and retrieve extracted text as a String.

workflows.name: Extract images from PDF
workflows.text: Load a Document, iterate over page resources' image collections, and save each XImage to a file stream.

workflows.name: Populate form fields
workflows.text: Load a Document, access Form via getForm(), retrieve fields by name, set values, and save the filled form.

workflows.name: Build form controls in table cells
workflows.text: Create a Cell, add TextFragment and RadioButtonOptionField instances in desired order, and add the cell to a table.

workflows.name: Configure widget annotation appearance
workflows.text: Create a WidgetAnnotation with a Rectangle, set border or background color via characteristics, and read back values.
